name: Bolon de Verde

ingredients.name: fresh mild cheese or paneer, crumbled

steps: Cut plantains into thick chunks. Pan-fry in 50 ml oil over medium heat 12–15 minutes, turning, until tender and lightly golden.
Mash the hot plantains with salt and a splash of warm water as needed until a cohesive dough forms.
Divide into eight portions. Flatten each, put cheese in the centre and close the mash around it to form a compact ball.
Brown the balls in remaining oil for 5–6 minutes, turning gently, until crisp outside and cheese warms through. Serve hot.
tips: Mash while hot; cooled green plantain becomes harder to bind into balls.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
